note: Shared source for the Plectrum-checkout agents. contracts:generate writes .cursor/agents/*.md, .github/agents/*.agent.md, .cursorrules and .github/copilot-instructions.md; contracts:generate --check fails on drift. Application-repository roles live in tools/devkit/roles.json.

roles.name: Plectrum
roles.description: Coordinator for the Plectrum Design System. Delegates to specialist subagents for research, engineering, implementation, testing, token auditing, and architecture.
roles.summary: Coordinator, invoked with /plectrum. Delegates to the specialists below; the only user-facing agent

roles.name: UX Researcher
roles.description: Inspects candidate nodes in Custom components and token variables in PrimeNG 21, then produces a structured design brief. Read-only.
roles.summary: Figma inspection, token extraction, design brief — read-only

roles.name: UX Engineer
roles.description: Implements SCSS tokens, BEMIT component styles, PrimeNG token bridges, and Storybook stories from a UX Researcher design brief.
roles.summary: SCSS tokens, BEMIT styles, PrimeNG bridges, Storybook stories; Figma writes via MCP when designing from the repo

roles.name: Frontend Dev
roles.description: Implements Angular components in libs/ui — TypeScript class, HTML template, accessibility, PrimeNG wiring, inputs/outputs, exports.
roles.summary: Angular implementation: class, template, accessibility, PrimeNG wiring

roles.name: Tester
roles.description: Validates Angular component unit tests, Storybook story coverage, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance. Fixes issues it finds.
roles.summary: Unit tests, story coverage, WCAG 2.1 AA

roles.name: Token Auditor
roles.description: Runs systematic token health checks — prefix compliance, semantic coverage, PrimeNG sync, and Figma drift. Produces actionable reports. Read-only.
roles.summary: Prefix compliance, semantic coverage, PrimeNG sync, Figma drift — read-only

roles.name: Architect
roles.description: Final authority on SSOT enforcement, ITCSS layer placement, file naming, and cross-library dependency boundaries. Read-only.
roles.summary: Keeps one catalogue, puts styles in the right folder, owns naming and dependency boundaries — read-only
